Tabukni ofis nokrogo, samung tangnairok glass bai kholobjak kok salainani room tei phiyogwi samung tangmani jagarogo samung tanglaikha. Busy wngwi tongphano, kaisa uansukmung tei kwtal wngmani uansukmung tongkha, abo tabukni jorao swkang thángnani tei thángnani lama no define khlaikha.

Buj thumjak train station himnani nexus wngwi samung tangkha, aro lekhajakya koktwmarok kwrwngwi phaikha. Salni chirikhogwi tongmani abo salno yachagwi tongnai rwchapmungrokni soft croon bai simi se swkakjak kha. Nainai rok belai kheno khakchangjak, lachima tei yak phologwi belai kheno kha khamjak jora tei dramatic turn wngwi phaikha. Kwchangma suburbs-o nokrok kaham khe row-o bachaui tong kha, khoroksa khoroksani sakni garden bai rangchak tei rangchak bai phuarjak. Tei horo wngwi phaima bai, porch ni light ni rangchak rangchak horo no yachak kha, suburban ni langmani kwchangma rhythm o tongwi.

Kwbangma jorao, rangchakni rangchakni khorang eba hatháini rangchakni nukmung adventurersrokno bohrokni gana-o tongnai rangchakni naithokmarokno muitu khlai rwkha. Swngcharni swkangni kamiyungni bazar-o samung khlaimani hive wngwi tongmani, aro bazar khlainairok bórokni manwirokno chirikhógwi tongmani tei rang-rirokno khá torwi bargain khlaiwi tongmani. Stall-o yak bai swnamjak manwirok, spices, tei textiles bai chapjak, abo kaisa-kaisa manwirok kamiyungni rangchakni culture-ni kaisa wngwi tongmani. Kaham khe tongnairokni rwchapmung tei dance ni khorangrok no teibo kwrak khlaikha. O bustling hub khe thwngmungni jaga simi ya; abo wng kha history, tongmung, tei borok bai kwrwngwi tongmani.

Horni chuknohani thani, campni hór thángwi thángwi thángnairokni mwkhango dancing shadows rwwi tháng kha. Crackling wngwi tongmani hór khe kwchangma nokbarni thani wngwi tongmani, aboni ulo khe sakani chwlarok khe paithago kwrwi uanamasingcha celestial canvas wngwi tongmani.
